{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data and apply the filter for valid baseline values
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')
valid_data = data[data['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Compute the change in biomarker level for each participant
valid_data['change'] = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the average change across all participants
average_change = valid_data['change'].mean()

average_change"}
